FX.title: [USD/JPY] DOWN: Risk-Off Surge and Technical Break Below MA20 Signal JPY Strength
tldr_points: Escalating geopolitical tensions in the Strait of Hormuz trigger risk-off flows, boosting safe-haven JPY.
Technical breakdown below the 20-period MA (157.88) confirms short-term bearish momentum.
US midterm election uncertainty and tech sector sell-off suppress USD demand, favoring a sell-the-rally approach.
FX.excerpt: Risk-off flows surge on Hormuz threats and US political shifts. USD/JPY remains bearish below MA20, targeting 156.50 support.
FX.comment: Bearish technical breakdown below the MA20 combined with risk-off flows from geopolitical escalation and US midterm uncertainty targets further downside.
